basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled, modern 2-bedroom, 1-bath unit in the highly sought-after Lake Street District, adjacent to prestigious Sea Cliff.  Located in an elevator building, residence 101 features refinished hardwood floors, fresh interior paint, and recessed lighting throughout. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting Caesarstone countertops, a Bosch appliance package, and a built-in microwave. The bathroom showcases custom tile work and Kohler fixtures.  Additional features include in-unit washer/dryer hookups, a private storage unit, common bike storage, low HOA dues, and the security of a fully completed seismic retrofit. Lightly lived in as a second home for the past 15 years, this residence is in pristine, like-new condition.  Enjoy an unbeatable location close to Baker Beach, the Presidio, China Beach, Lands End, the Legion of Honor, & all the amazing restaurants on Clement st.
